channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Federal Agency Proceeds Without DC, Virginia on Trump's Arch
item.description: Virginia agency says Park Service has not attempted to resolve opposition.

item.title: Americans face record gas price increases
item.description: GasBuddy analyst Patrick De Haan discusses the outlook for gas prices as the national average for regular fuel climbs by more than $1.50.

item.title: Facebook held liable for deceiving users in Cambridge Analytica case
item.description: A two-week trial in New Mexico focused on allegations that Facebook misled users about a data breach.

item.title: Nor'easter forecast for the weekend
item.description: Millions across the Northeast are preparing for a powerful nor'easter expected to bring heavy rain and strong winds through the weekend.
